items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: After I finished the big band job he asked me to play with this small group, and Wallace was the other trumpet.

ctx.x: Okay well Wallace was on the band, the small group. After I finished the big band job he asked me to play with this small group, and Wallace was the other trumpet. The guy was unreal. He could circular breathe on double high Cs. I go, “Wallace” and he was super nice. He studied French all the time on the bus. And I said, “Why are you studying — are you going to France?” He says, “No, no” he said, “I’m going back to New Orleans and a lot of the people that I hang out with, they speak French and I’m going to get…
